title: What can machine learning discover about the nature of emotion?
title_zh: 机器学习能揭示情感本质的哪些信息？
abstract: The science of emotion increasingly relies on machine learning (ML) in the hope of making objective discoveries that resolve century-long debates. We examine research strategies in two main research traditions and show how confirmation bias can arise when theory-based hypotheses are evaluated using theory-laden sampling strategies, model specifications, and inferences. Each tradition manifests its theoretical differences in its ML methods, and, therefore, ML methods cannot settle those differences. The reciprocal relationships between starting assumptions, findings, and conclusions illustrate that ML investigations of emotion, like all scientific investigations, are never free from human experience and beliefs; however, they can be made less biased through a theory-aware research strategy to generate more justified knowledge about emotion.
abstract_zh: 情感科学正日益依赖机器学习（ML），以期通过客观发现解决长期争议。本文考察了两大研究传统中的研究策略，并展示了当基于理论的假设采用带有理论色彩的抽样策略、模型规范和推断时，如何产生确认偏差。每种传统在其 ML 方法中体现了理论差异，因此 ML 方法无法解决这些差异。起始假设、发现与结论之间的相互关系表明，像所有科学研究一样，情感的 ML 调查从未摆脱人类经验和信念的影响；然而，通过采用理论意识的研究策略，可减少偏差，从而生成更有依据的情感知识。
